free_tier.stated: the agent is free to use under FSL-1.1-MIT with keys for many providers; its first-party provider Charm Hyper has no free plan ('We've retired the monthly free Hypercredit allowance') and starts at Shred Diet, USD 10 a month for 180 Hypercredits a week
free_tier.notes: the agent imposes no quota; with Hyper as the endpoint, the weekly and five-hour Hypercredit windows bind

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a coding agent meters nothing itself

egress.terms: not applicable: the chosen endpoint serves the inference

interface_detail: a terminal UI. Headless: `crush run "prompt"` runs non-interactively, `--continue` (`-C`) and `--session` (`-s`) resume a session, `crush session list --json` lists sessions, and `--yolo` skips every permission prompt
tooling: the user installs and runs the crush binary (Homebrew, npm, winget, scoop, apt, yum or go install) on a rented or free machine; providers come from the Catwalk model list or a custom OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible entry, and the HYPER_API_KEY variable selects Hyper
chaining: Charm Hyper is the first-party endpoint at hyper.charm.land/v1 with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols: Shred Diet USD 10 a month buys 180 Hypercredits a week (about USD 9.00 of inference at 5 cents a credit), 100 per five hours and 2 concurrent requests; Shred Classic is USD 20 for 250; prepaid credits start at USD 5. Any key in inference/ works instead
limits_note: the agent carries no vendor-imposed usage cap, since the vendor serves no inference through it unless Hyper is chosen; Hyper's weekly and five-hour Hypercredit limits then bind
binding_note: the agent has no quota of its own; the endpoint's quota decides capacity

identity_cost.detail: no account for the agent, which installs from package managers; Hyper sign-up is 'Sign up with Google, GitHub, or email', and a Shred plan or prepaid credit is billed through Stripe

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded; Shred subscriptions on Hyper are not zero-data-retention, while Business plans and prepaid credits are
confidence_note: licence, headless command, provider support and the Hyper plan table are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-10-30, and the Hyper model list from a probe of its unauthenticated models endpoint. Hyper's per-model token price inside a Hypercredit was not converted to tokens per week.
